verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an HTTP API that is compatible with the OpenAI and Anthropic protocols, plus downloadable OpenAPI specs. It never mentions an official Kimi-published SDK package for any language. Protocol compatibility only lets users reuse third-party SDKs, and an OpenAPI document is a building block for generating clients, so neither is the product shipping official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
